  return false;\n753\t        }\n754\t\n755\t        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n756\t            return false;\n757\t        };\n758\t\n759\t        if days == 0 {\n760\t false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare labels (order independent)\n        let mut self_labels = self.labels.clone();\n        self_labels.sort_unstable();\n        self_labels.dedup();\n        let mut other_labels = other.labels.clone();\n        other_labels.sort_unstable();\n        other_labels.dedup();\n        if self_labels != other_labels {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare dependencies (order independent)\n        let mut self_deps = self.dependencies.clone();\n        self_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n         .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        let mut other_deps = other.dependencies.clone();\n        other_deps.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.created_by.cmp(&right.created_by))\n                .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        if self_deps != other_deps {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare comments (order independent)\n        let mut self_comments = self.comments.clone();\n        self_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        if self_comments != other_comments {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n    }\n}\n\n/// Epic Arguments\n980\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n981\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n982\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n983\t    ///\n984\t    /// # Returns\n985\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n986\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n987\t        &self,\n988\t        root_id: &str,\n989\t        direction: &str,\n990\t        max_depth: usize,\n991\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n992\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n993\t\n994\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n995\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n996\t            \"up\" => {\n997\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n998\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n999\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n1000\t                (\n1001\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n1002\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n1003\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n1004\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n1005\t                )\n1006\t            }\n1007\t            _ => {\n1008\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n1009\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n1010\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n1011\t                (\n1012\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n1013\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n1014\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n1015\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n1016\t                )\n1017\t            }\n1018\t        };\n1019\t\n1020\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n1021\t            String::new()\n1022\t        } else {\n1023\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n1024\t        };\n1025\t\n1026\t        let sql = format!(\n1027\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n1028\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n1029\t                SELECT\n1030\t                    {id_col} as id,\n1031\t                    i.title,\n1032\t                    i.status,\n1033\t                    i.priority,\n1034\t                    0 as depth,\n1035\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n1036\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n1037\t                FROM dependencies d\n1038\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n1039\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n1040\t\n1041\t                UNION ALL\n1042\t\n1043\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n1044\t                SELECT\n1045\t                    {id_col} as id,\n1046\t                    i.title,\n1047\t                    i.status,\n1048\t                    i.priority,\n1049\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n1050\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n1051\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n1052\t                FROM dependencies d\n1053\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n1054\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n1055\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n1056\t                {depth_limit}\n1057\t            )\n1058\t            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n1059\t            FROM dep_tree\n1060\t            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n1061\t        );\n1062\t\n1063\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n1064\t        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n1065\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n1066\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1067\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n1068\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n1069\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n1070\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n1071\t\n1072\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n1073\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n1074\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n1075\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n1076\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n1077\t                depth: row.get(4)?,\n1078\t                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n1079\t                path: if is_cycle {\n1080\t                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n1081\t                } else {\n1082\t                    path\n1083\t                },\n1084\t            });\n1085\t        }\n1086\t        Ok(nodes)\n1087\t    }\n1088\t\n1089\t    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) ->    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n1434\t    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n1435\t    ///\n1436\t    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n1437\t    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n1438\t    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n1439\t    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n1440\t    ///\n1441\t    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n1442\t    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n1443\t    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n1444\t    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n1445\t        &self,\n1446\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1447\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1448\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1449\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1450\t\n1451\t        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n1452\t            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n1453\t (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n1462\t                 FROM issues i\n1463\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1464\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1465\t                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type =                 SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1475\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1476\t                       WHERE                  downstream_impact DESC,\n1484\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1485\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1486\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1487\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1488\t            )?;\n1489\t\n1490\t            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n1491\t            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1492\t                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n1493\t                    row.get(0)?,\n1494\t                    row.get(1)?,\n1495\t                    row.get(2)?,\n1496\t                    row.get(3)?,\n1497\t                    row.get(4)?,\n1498\t                    row.get(5)?,\n1499\t                )))\n1500\t            } else {\n1501\t                Ok(None)\n1502\t            }\n1503\t        } else {\n1504\t            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n1505\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1506\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM dirty_issues\", [])?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn create_issue(&self, issue: &Issue) -> Result<()> {\n        // Scan for secrets before creating\n        if let Err(SecretError(format_secret_matches(&matches)).into());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Compute content_hash if not already set, and wrap in Some for storage\n        let content_hash: // Validate that the bead exists\n        let exists = {\n            let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n            match conn.query_row(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                params![id],\n                |_| Ok(true),\n            ) {\n                Ok(result) => result,\n                Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => false,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n            }\n        };\n        if !exists {\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n        }\n\n        // Scan for secrets before updating (only for string fields in changes)\n        if let Some(scanner) = &*self.secret_scanner.lock().unwrap() {\n            let mut all_matches = Vec::new();\n            for field in [\n                changes.title.as_deref(),\n                changes.description.as_deref(),\n                changes.design.as_deref(),\n                changes.acceptance_criteria.as_deref(),\n                changes.notes.as_deref(),\n                changes.assignee.as_deref(),\n                changes.owner.as_deref(),\n                changes.external_ref.as_deref(),\n            ] {\n                if let Some(value) = field {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(labels) = &changes.labels {\n                for label in labels {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(label));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(annotations) = &changes.annotations {\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(key));\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if !all_matches.is_empty() {\n                return Err(SecretError(format_secret_matches(&all_matches)).into());\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Get current status before update (for reopen detection)\n            let current_status: Option<Status> = tx.query_row(\n                \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                params![id],\n                |row| {\n                    let status_str: String = row.get(0)?;\n                    Ok(match status_str.as_str() {\n                        \"open\" => Status::Open,\n                        \"in_progress\" => Status::InProgress,\n                        \"blocked\" => Status::Blocked,\n                        \"deferred\" => Status::Deferred,\n                        \"draft\" => Status::Draft,\n                        \"closed\" => Status::Closed,\n                        \"tombstone\" => Status::Tombstone,\n                        \"pinned\" => Status::Pinned,\n                        _ => Status::Custom(status_str),\n                    })\n                },\n            ).ok();\n\n            let mut updates = Vec::new();\n            let mut params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = Vec::new();\n            if let Some(ref title) = changes.title {\n                updates.push(\"title = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(title.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref description) = changes.description {\n                updates.push(\"description = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(description.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref design) = changes.design {\n                updates.push(\"design = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(design.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref acceptance_criteria) = changes.acceptance_criteria {\n                updates.push(\"acceptance_criteria = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(acceptance_criteria.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref notes) = changes.notes {\n                updates.push(\"notes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(notes.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref status) = changes.status {\n                updates.push(\"status = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(status.to_string()));\n                // Clear closed fields when transitioning from closed/tombstone to open\n                if !matches!(status, Status::Closed | Status::Tombstone) {\n                    updates.push(\"closed_at = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"close_reason = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"closed_by_session = NULL\");\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(priority) = changes.priority {\n                updates.push(\"priority = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(priority));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref issue_type) = changes.issue_type {\n                updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(issue_type.to_string()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                updates.push(\"assignee = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(assignee.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref owner) = changes.owner {\n                updates.push(\"owner = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(estimated_minutes) = changes.estimated_minutes {\n                updates.push(\"estimated_minutes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(estimated_minutes));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref due_at) = changes.due_at {\n                updates.push(\"due_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(due_at.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref defer_until) = changes.defer_until {\n                updates.push(\"defer_until = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(defer_until.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref external_ref) = changes.external_ref {\n                updates.push(\"external_ref = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(external_ref.clone()));\n            }\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            if !updates.is_empty() {\n                updates.push(\"updated_at = ?\");\n rusqlite::ToSql>> = params.into_iter().collect();\n                all_params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()));\n                let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n                    all_params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n                tx.execute(&query, param_refs.as_slice())?;\n\n                // Create a Reopened event if transitioning from closed/tombstone to active status\n                if let (Some(current), Some(new)) = (current_status, changes.status.as_ref()) {\n                    if current.is_terminal() && !new.is_terminal() {\n                        let actor = changes.actor.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"system\");\n                        let now = Utc::now();\n                        tx.execute(\n                            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'reopened', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                            params![id, actor, current.as_str(), new.as_str(), now.to_rfc3339()],\n                        )?;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle label updates separately\n            if let Some(ref labels) = changes.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![id])?;\n                for label in labels {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![id, label],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle annotation updates separately\n            if let Some(ref annotations) = changes.annotations {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing issue with the imported data,\n    /// used during JSONL import when the close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Check if bead exists\n            let exists: bool = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |_| Ok(true),\n                )\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n            if !exists {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n            }\n\n            // Check if already closed for idempotence\n            let current_status: Option<String> = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |row| row.get(0),\n                )\n                .ok();\n\n            if current_status.as_deref() == Some(\"closed\") {\n                // Already closed - idempotent, return success\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n\n            // Close the bead\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, closed_by_session = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, actor, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'closed', ?2, NULL, ?3, ?4)\",\n                params![id, actor, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time and duration for velocity tracking\n            crate::velocity::update_session_on_close(tx, id, now)?;\n            // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn mark_dirty(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n            params![id, now],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn rebuild_blocked_cache(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n                 SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n                 FROM dependencies d\n                 INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                 WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone')\n                 GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n                params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn count_issues(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n        Ok(count as usize)\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_from_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ImportResult> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n                let existing = Self::get_issue_tx(tx, &issue.id)?;\n                match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                    Some(existing_issue) => {\n                        // Compute hash from incoming issue (content_hash is None from JSONL due to #[serde(skip)])\n                        let incoming_hash = issue.content_hash();\n                        if existing_issue.content_hash.as_ref() != Some(&incoming_hash) {\n                            Self::update_issue_from_json_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n                jsonl_path,\n                || self.list_dirty_issues(),\n                || self.clear_dirty(),\n            )?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        } else {\n            let result = export_jsonl(jsonl_path, || self.list_all_issues())?;\n            // Clear dirty flags after full export (all beads are now synced)\n            self.clear_dirty()?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_issue_conn(conn: &Connection, row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Issue> {\n        let status_str: String = row.get(7)?;\n        let type_str: String = row.get(9)?;\n        let parse_opt_dt = |idx: usize| -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {\n            let s: Option<String> = row.get(idx)?;\n            match s {\n                None => Ok(None),\n                Some(ref val) if val.is_empty() => Ok(None),\n                Some(val) => Ok(Some(parse_datetime(val)?)),\n            }\n        };\n        let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        Ok(Issue {\n            content_hash: row.get(1)?,\n            title: row.get(2)?,\n            description: row.get(3)?,\n            design: row.get(4)?,\n            acceptance_criteria: row.get(5)?,\n            notes: row.get(6)?,\n            status: Status::from_str(&status_str).unwrap_or(Status::Custom(status_str)),\n            priority: row.get(8)?,\n            issue_type: IssueType::from_str(&type_str).unwrap_or(IssueType::Custom(type_str)),\n            assignee: row.get(10)?,\n            owner: row.get(11)?,\n            estimated_minutes: row.get(12)?,\n            created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(13)?)?,\n            created_by: row.get(14)?,\n            updated_at: parse_datetime(row.get(15)?)?,\n            closed_at: parse_opt_dt(16)?,\n            close_reason: row.get(17)?,\n            closed_by_session: row.get(18)?,\n            due_at: parse_opt_dt(19)?,\n            defer_until: parse_opt_dt(20)?,\n            external_ref: row.get(21)?,\n            source_system: row.get(22)?,\n            source_repo: row.get(23)?,\n            deleted_at: parse_opt_dt(24)?,\n            deleted_by: row.get(25)?,\n            delete_reason: row.get(26)?,\n            original_type: row.get(27)?,\n            compaction_level: row.get(28)?,\n            compacted_at: parse_opt_dt(29)?,\n            compacted_at_commit: row.get(30)?,\n            original_size: row.get(31)?,\n            sender: row.get(32)?,\n            ephemeral: row.get::<_, i32>(33)? != 0,\n            pinned: row.get::<_, i32>(34)? != 0,\n            is_template: row.get::<_, i32>(35)? != 0,\n            labels: Self::load_labels_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            dependencies: Self::load_dependencies_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            comments: Self::load_comments_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            annotations: Self::load_annotations_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            id,\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn load_labels_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT label FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\")?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut labels = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            labels.push(row.get(0)?);\n        }\n        Ok(labels)\n    }\n\n    fn load_dependencies_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id, created_at, created_by FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    fn load_comments_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Comment>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT id, an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id, created_at, created_by FROM dependencies WHERE depends_on_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![depends_on_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n            deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub       \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\",  let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row:      params![issue_id],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn search_issues(\n        &self,\n        query: Option<&str>,\n        status: &[Status],\n        issue_type: &[IssueType],\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        let open: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        let in_progress: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE status = = 'closed' AND deleted_at IS NULL\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        Ok(Stats {\n            total: total as usize,\n            open: open as usize,\n            in_progress: in_progress as usize,\n            closed: closed as usize,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_type(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, i64)>> {\n        let conn =  }\n\n    pub fn get_stats_by_priority(&self) -> Result<Vec<(i32, i64)>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM DESC\")?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n        let mut result = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            result.push((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?));\n        }\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n    ///\n    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n768\t        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n769\t        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n770\t        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n771\t        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n772\t    }\n773\t}\n774\t\n775\t/// Epic completion status with child `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n315\t/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n316\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n317\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n318\t/// - A (outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = bytes.len();\n327\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n328\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n329\t    let mut i = 0;\n330\t\n331\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n332\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n333\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n334\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n335\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n336\t\n337\t    while i < len {\n338\t        let b = bytes[i];\n339\t\n340\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n341\t        if in_line_comment {\n342\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n343\t                in_line_comment = false;\n344\t            }\n345\t            i += 1;\n346\t            continue;\n347\t        }\n348\t\n349\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n350\t        if {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n363\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n364\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n365\t                    i += 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"' {\n379\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n380\t                    i += 2;\n381\t                } else {\n382\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n383\t                    i += 1;\n384\t                }\n385\t            } else {\n386\t                i += 1;\n387\t            }\n388\t            continue;\n389\t        }\n390\t\n391\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n392\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n393\t            in_single_quote = true;\n394\t            i += 1;\n395\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n396\t            in_double_quote = true;\n397\t            i += 1;\n398\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n399\t            in_line_comment = true;\n400\t            i += 2;\n401\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n402\t            in_block_comment = true;\n403\t            i += 2;\n404\t        } else if b == b';' {\n405\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n406\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n407\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n408\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n409\t            }\n410\t            start = i + 1;\n411\t
